verdict.rationale: Bruno is a local-first API client and testing tool. Managing API gateway infrastructure as declarative config and syncing it from CI (GitOps/APIOps for gateway traffic) belongs to API gateway and management products, so this axis is a category error for an API client. The evidence that collections are plain-text files in Git and that the CLI runs them in CI concerns test collections, not gateway infrastructure. It does not show Bruno ships this capability, so it cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can manage API infrastructure as declarative config and sync it from CI (GitOps/APIOps)
